mode.label: Mode
mode.description: Which widget this instance shows. Each instance keeps its own settings.

weather_location.label: Weather location
weather_location.description: City name, or latitude,longitude. Leave empty to use the shell Location address, then Jakarta.

weather_units.label: Units
weather_units.description: Temperature and wind units used by the weather widget and the user card.

clock_style.label: Style
clock_style.description: Digital shows one time line, stacked splits hours and minutes, compact drops the date.

clock_show_seconds.label: Show seconds
clock_show_seconds.description: Add a seconds readout and tick once per second.

clock_time_format.label: Time format
clock_time_format.description: Leave empty to follow the shell time format.

clock_timezone.label: Timezone
clock_timezone.description: IANA name such as Asia/Jakarta. Leave empty for local time.

clock_color.label: Time color
clock_color.description: Palette role or hex color for the time.

clock_date_color.label: Date color
clock_date_color.description: Palette role or hex color for the date.

clock_shadow.label: Text shadow
clock_shadow.description: Draw a shadow behind the text for readability on wallpapers. Requires Noctalia 5.5 or newer.

clock_width.label: Width
clock_width.description: Content width in logical pixels. 0 uses the style default.

weather_show_forecast.label: Show forecast
weather_show_forecast.description: Add a row of upcoming days.

weather_forecast_days.label: Forecast days
weather_forecast_days.description: How many days the forecast row shows.

weather_show_details.label: Show details
weather_show_details.description: Show humidity, wind and rain probability.

weather_show_feels.label: Show feels like
weather_show_feels.description: Show the apparent temperature beside the location.

weather_color.label: Accent color
weather_color.description: Palette role or hex color for the temperature and weather glyph.

weather_shadow.label: Text shadow
weather_shadow.description: Draw a shadow behind the text for readability on wallpapers. Requires Noctalia 5.5 or newer.

system_metric.label: Metric
system_metric.description: Which resource the tile shows. All shows CPU, RAM and battery rows.

system_color.label: Accent color
system_color.description: Palette role or hex color. Error and tertiary replace it at warning levels.

system_show_detail.label: Show details
system_show_detail.description: Show temperature and frequency, memory totals, or battery state.

system_show_bar.label: Show progress bar
system_show_bar.description: Draw a bar under the value.

system_warn_threshold.label: Warning threshold
system_warn_threshold.description: CPU and RAM percentages at or above this value turn error-colored.

system_shadow.label: Text shadow
system_shadow.description: Draw a shadow behind the text for readability on wallpapers. Requires Noctalia 5.5 or newer.

system_width.label: Width
system_width.description: Content width in logical pixels. 0 uses the metric default.

media_show_art.label: Show artwork
media_show_art.description: Show the current track's album art.

media_color.label: Accent color
media_color.description: Palette role or hex color for the progress bar and play button.

media_shadow.label: Text shadow
media_shadow.description: Draw a shadow behind the text for readability on wallpapers. Requires Noctalia 5.5 or newer.

world_zones.label: Zones
world_zones.description: One entry per zone as Label=IANA/Zone, or just the IANA zone. Examples: Tokyo=Asia/Tokyo, Europe/London.

world_show_local.label: Show local time
world_show_local.description: Show the large local clock above the zone list.

world_local_label.label: Local label
world_local_label.description: Label above the local time. Leave empty to use the shell Location address, then Local.

world_show_date.label: Show date
world_show_date.description: Show the local date under the local time.

world_time_format.label: Time format
world_time_format.description: Leave empty to follow the shell time format.

world_show_gmt.label: Show GMT offset
world_show_gmt.description: Show each zone's current offset, such as GMT+9.

world_columns.label: Columns
world_columns.description: Lay the zones out in one or two columns.

world_color.label: Time color
world_color.description: Palette role or hex color for the clock values.

world_secondary_color.label: Label color
world_secondary_color.description: Palette role or hex color for labels, dates and offsets.

world_shadow.label: Text shadow
world_shadow.description: Draw a shadow behind the text for readability on wallpapers. Requires Noctalia 5.5 or newer.

calendar_week_start.label: Week starts
calendar_week_start.description: First column of the month grid.

calendar_color.label: Accent color
calendar_color.description: Palette role or hex color for today and the month controls.

calendar_text_color.label: Text color
calendar_text_color.description: Palette role or hex color for day numbers.

calendar_shadow.label: Text shadow
calendar_shadow.description: Draw a shadow behind the text for readability on wallpapers. Requires Noctalia 5.5 or newer.

usercard_name.label: Display name
usercard_name.description: Override the name read from the accounts service.

usercard_avatar.label: Avatar
usercard_avatar.description: Image file. Leave empty to use Noctalia's avatar, AccountsService, ~/.face, or an initial.

usercard_show_weather.label: Show weather
usercard_show_weather.description: Show the current temperature and condition.

usercard_show_uptime.label: Show uptime
usercard_show_uptime.description: Show how long the system has been running.

usercard_show_actions.label: Show actions
usercard_show_actions.description: Show lock, settings and power buttons.

usercard_color.label: Accent color
usercard_color.description: Palette role or hex color for the name and buttons.

usercard_shadow.label: Text shadow
usercard_shadow.description: Draw a shadow behind the text for readability on wallpapers. Requires Noctalia 5.5 or newer.

converter_fallback_dir.label: Fallback folder
converter_fallback_dir.description: Directory used when the input folder cannot be written.

system.monitor_off_hint: Enable it under Settings → System Monitor.

world.no_zones: Add a zone in the widget settings.

converter.failed: Conversion failed. Install ImageMagick or FFmpeg.
converter.no_picker: Install zenity, kdialog, or yad to choose an image.
